_comment: Tier-2: PoroNewmarkQuasistaticUPlScheme takes (theta_u, theta_p, beta, gamma) — thetas FIRST — and the scheme additionally requires several ProcessInfo entries, with RAYLEIGH_ALPHA/BETA only existing once StructuralMechanicsApplication is imported. Pitfall (kratos.poromechanics #5). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). The four-argument constructor accepts the documented defaults (0.5, 0.5, 0.25, 0.5) and rejects a three-argument call, so the arity is pinned; every ProcessInfo variable the claim names resolves through KratosGlobals.GetVariable once SMA is loaded. The claim's warning that a WRONG ARGUMENT ORDER still runs is why arity is the only thing a fixture can check here — swapping thetas and beta/gamma is silently accepted. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 INVERTS the expected outcome of all 10 probes -- it asserts the opposite of what this build actually does, while leaving each probe's callable untouched so every probe still really runs against Kratos. Every probe[...] line then disagrees with itself and probe_mismatches goes from 0 to 10. This proves the printed booleans come from actually calling into Kratos on this build, and that a wrong claim is caught, rather than the fixture echoing a hard-coded table. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: all 10 probe[<label>]=<ok>_expected=<must> lines, probe_mismatches=0. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/poromechanics_newmark_scheme_signature && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers.
